Campaigns.explanation: Charity receivers create cooking campaigns with a kitchen location and schedule. Volunteers browse open campaigns sorted by distance from their own position, which is why the query goes through $queryRaw with ST_Distance. Volunteers apply to a campaign (or a specific shift); the campaign owner approves or rejects - the slot counter on CampaignShift is updated in the same transaction as the assignment, so two parallel approvals can never overbook a shift. The owner drives the campaign through its status chain and can cancel it; shifts, menu items and change requests are composed by the campaign, so cancelling the campaign cascades the plan while keeping the assignment rows for volunteer history. Providers pledge cash or in-kind donations; the campaign owner submits change requests for admin review - both donations and change requests cascade with the campaign, and approving a change request applies the new value directly onto the campaign.
